tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Task filter/query surface does not directly express ordinary project/status/tag/date/assignee selection.

It used calendar_list and task_resolve as workarounds. Gemini screened both full pages. Both final state checks passed, but Luna needed more rounds. Diagnostic omission is separate evidence, not part of final-suite score. Final repeat2: Luna read both pages but saved22/24 targets and reported23; Gemini saved/reported24. This supports testing structured selection and receipt counts, without proving those changes will eliminate model omissions. Repeat3: Luna saved23/24, omitting Audit item097 from fully read results, and did not disclose incomplete coverage; Gemini saved/reported24.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Add validated structured filters for project_id, exact status, assignee_id, required/excluded tags and due-date bounds; explicitly describe title-only query semantics versus task_resolve broader search. Return matched count and stable pagination cursor.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Replay frozen bulk/decoy cases unchanged on both models after implementation; verify inclusive boundaries, multiple filters, owner scoping, pagination under concurrent writes and unchanged unrelated fields. Measure tokens/rounds and coverage; do not assume filter addition alone causes reliability improvement.

tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Include applied_count, unique target IDs and changed-fields summary in batch result; bind a server-evaluated selection preview to revisions and report expected-versus-applied counts. Prompt final answer to use receipt counts.

tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Expose durable retry versus assistant follow-up explicitly, with terminal=false, retry_after or next_attempt_at and clear 'do not re-create' outcome. Add bounded wait/status guidance; never imply a follow-up notification unless registered.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Use delayed-success, persistent retry, failure and consent-change fixtures; measure redundant polls and unsupported monitoring claims while verifying no duplicate create.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Malformed copied UUID becomes generic NOT_FOUND, and the model may infer the record disappeared instead of repairing the identifier.

Consider owner-scoped opaque result handles bound to canonical ID/revision so model need not retype UUIDs. Do not auto-select nearest IDs or silently mutate guessed targets.

Retest both models on original cases and fresh IDs. Original observed typo and unsupported availability inference are model errors, not a proven storage bug.
